quests.title: The the Hero of Waterloo Lift
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. The lift at Circular Quay station has been out since the Easter Show and I'm told Milsons Point is worse. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Check both Wednesday and tell me which takes a pram. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: check the lift at Circular Quay station
then ride to Milsons Point and check theirs
report which one works

quests.title: The the Opera House Tab
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Two chippies off the the Opera House job have run a tab in Circular Quay since Sunday. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. They drove past at the last train without looking in, so settle it in cash. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: collect from the two chippies near the Opera House
and bring back thirty of it

quests.title: The the Opera House Complaint
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Two women in activewear have photographed my bins outside the Opera House since Melbourne Cup day. This is the third time I have had this conversation. One has Circular Quay council on speed dial; sort it however you sort things. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: deal with the two of them near the Opera House

quests.title: Closing Time at the Harbour Bridge
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on the Harbour Bridge since the pub shut. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. The Circular Quay delivery's at midnight, so get them up and show me the step empty. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off the Harbour Bridge
and show me the doorway clear

quests.title: Seven a.m. At the Harbour Bridge
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The site at the Harbour Bridge starts its jackhammer at the last train on a Sunday, which is illegal and loud. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Photograph it running and have a word with the Circular Quay foreman. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: photograph the noise from the Harbour Bridge
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: Something From the Manly ferry
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. The stall at the Manly ferry has run out and the customers keep coming. It started small, the way these things do. Find something round Circular Quay that'll do before the nine sharp rush. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: pick something up near the Manly ferry
bring it to the stall

quests.title: Staffy Near the Manly ferry
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at the Manly ferry at the arvo. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Everyone in Circular Quay has definitely seen it and can't say where. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near the Manly ferry
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: The the Rocks Camera
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. A new speed camera near the Rocks has fined half of Circular Quay since Friday. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Photograph it for the appeal, then prove the train to Milsons Point is faster anyway. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: photograph the camera near the Rocks
then take the train instead, to Milsons Point

quests.title: Proof of the Rocks
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. Nobody in Circular Quay believes what the Rocks looks like at nine sharp. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Get me a photo close enough that council can't say it's somewhere else. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: get a picture of the Rocks before they fix it

quests.title: The the Cahill Expressway Order
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The the Cahill Expressway order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by school pick-up. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Find seventy in Circular Quay and photograph the receipt. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: square the seventy for the the Cahill Expressway order
then photograph the receipt on the counter

quests.title: Bin Night, Customs House
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Somebody moves the bins on Customs House in front of my drive every Friday night. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Circular Quay knows who. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: photograph the bins at Customs House
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: Before They Touch Customs House
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. They start on Customs House on Anzac Day and the orange fencing goes up. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I want Circular Quay on record before it does. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: photograph the state of Customs House
then the other end of it

quests.title: Lads Off Customs House
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Three of them in TNs on the Customs House steps, flogging vapes to schoolkids at school pick-up. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Circular Quay used to move them on itself and now it rings me. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: move the lads on from Customs House

quests.title: Meat Tray at the Museum of Contemporary Art
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The the Museum of Contemporary Art raffle is thirty-five short of a meat tray and the draw is at eight at night. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Find it in Circular Quay and put it in the tin. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: raise thirty-five for the meat tray
and drop it at the Museum of Contemporary Art
